Record notes

Build or improve interactive MCP apps and their servers, from a clear user task through protocol and host verification. Complete public edition: 2 retained skill heads; no restricted source methods omitted.

Version 1.0.4 includes 2 complete skill procedures. Complete methods and Apache source; no provider-hosted service.

Requirements: Host coding tools; Runtime named by the selected workflow.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add build-mcp-apps@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
